entities.summary: Manuel Edmilson da Cruz is a Brazilian Roman Catholic prelate, who served as Titular Bishop of Vicus Cæsaris, Auxiliary Bishop of Archdiocese of São Luís do Maranhão, Auxiliary Bishop of Archdiocese of Fortaleza, Apostolic Administrator sede plena of Limoeiro do Norte and the Diocesan Bishop of Limoeiro do Norte.
